summary: Perpetuals.com Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting financial results for the six months ended October 31, 2025, along with a press release and unaudited interim financial statements. The filing also mentions recent corporate developments and forward-looking statements. No specific deal terms, transactions, or events that constitute a special situation are present. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. quarterly report, with no indication of acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, management changes, or other special situations.
